notes: Single-card promo ("Right Arm of the Forbidden One") bundled with the first DM2 strategy guide book (Shueisha, ISBN 4-08-779026-6). Corroborated by Konami's own product-catalogue listing page, which files this book under a distinct "books" category separate from the game-bundled promo, and by independent Japanese publisher (openBD/National Diet Library) metadata for the ISBN, which places the book's publication in July 1999 (month-level, consistent with the day-level Konami date). Status upgraded reported -> verified: 2+ independent official channels now agree. Pool impact: none - 1999-07-13 remains well before the 1999-08-25 cutoff, same as the prior, incorrect date.
